card.summary: Unlimited, $25 per TB per month. S3-compatible.

free_tier.stated: Unlimited, $25 per TB per month. S3-compatible.

egress.terms: **$0 ingress, $0 egress, $0 request fees. Stated three ways on the same page** ('$25 per TB with $0 request, ingress or egress fees', 'Ingress and egress CacheFly is always free', 'no ingress or egress fees'). If the object storage is fronted by CacheFly's own CDN, delivery is included in the $25.

record.chaining: For a serving-heavy workload this is the cheapest egress-free paid option found: 1 TB stored and 30 TB/mo delivered costs $25/mo total, because the only metre is bytes at rest. That inverts the usual model. Storage is the expensive line and egress is genuinely free. Pair with the free CDN tier (100 GB/mo) for the small hot set and put the 20 TiB cold archive elsewhere.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: not stated on the page opened; no published cap. Request fees $0. Free developer account is 100 GB/month on one domain then $0.05/GB overage.
record.reliability_note: Self-signup 'requires a credit card at registration … charged and refunded $1 to authenticate'. 65+ PoPs, 99.95% SLA. Object storage onboarding is sales-gated ('Sign Up' → contact-object-storage form), unlike the CDN developer account which is instant.
